verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents an `id_number` verification type that checks a user's name, date of birth and national ID number without a document scan, and it explicitly advertises SSN validation, so the core document-free data check is delivered via the same Verification Sessions API. Missing for 10: any evidence of credit-header data sources, which national registries or countries the id_number check covers beyond SSN, detail on match results, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the document-free flow.
